cond_0256.intro: We are looking for a Program Analyst to join our team at [Company name masked]. This role involves senior-level planning, organizing, and determining necessary policies, regulations, directives, programs, doctrine, and procedures for the establishment and maintenance of [Company name masked] program areas and missions. Specifically serves as analyst for the articulation and development of branch, division, and command requirements processes as well as advanced concepts and experimentation in the realm of Research and Development (R&D) and Science and Technology (S&T) for space. Performs substantive planning, advocacy, and requirements work in support of one or more command programs and missions expanding across eight different mission areas (to include space propulsion, sustained space maneuver / operations, electronic warfare, directed energy, cyber, artificial intelligence / machine learning, multi-domain effects, and xGEO). Additionally supports system allocation, modernization, force management and analysis to include integrating, coordinating, prioritizing, and advocating for [Company name masked] future concepts, mission capability needs, weapon systems development, support for emerging technologies and command and control architecture across the mission areas. Supports development of Commander, [Company name masked]'s Planning, Programming, Budgeting and Executing (PPBE) in the Science and Technology arena. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of space operations and R&D requirements work.

Skill in designing and conducting comprehensive studies and preparing solutions to especially broad, important, and severe military operational and contingency areas.

cond_0290.intro: To serve as a combatant command headquarters level senior program analyst planning, organizing, and determining necessary policies, regulations, directives, programs, doctrine, and procedures for the establishment and maintenance of [Company name masked] program areas and missions. Specifically serves as analyst for the articulation and development of branch, division, and command requirements processes as well-advanced concepts and experimentation in the realm of Research and Development (R&D) and Science and Technology (S&T) for space. Performs substantive planning, advocacy, and requirements work in support of one or more command programs and missions expanding across eight different mission areas (to include space propulsion, sustained space maneuver / operations, electronic warfare, directed energy, cyber, artificial intelligence / machine learning, multi-domain effects, and xGEO). Additionally supports system allocation, modernization, force management and analysis to include integrating, coordinating, prioritizing, and advocating for [Company name masked] future concepts, mission capability needs, weapon systems development, support for emerging technologies and command and control architecture across the mission areas. cond_0290.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Advanced knowledge of a wide range of qualitative and/or quantitative methods for the assessment and improvement of command level plans and programs for conducting major operations across eight different mission areas (to include space propulsion, sustained space maneuver / operations, electronic warfare, directed energy, cyber, artificial intelligence / machine learning, multi-domain effects, and xGEO), and associated mission and flight operations, tactical space lift, deployment, mobilization, exercise, training systems, foreign military sales, Planning, Programming, & Budgeting System (PPBE), congressionally allocated appropriated science and technology funding, acquisition, special operations, or similar operations.
Deep knowledge of military (including command level) program goals and objectives; the sequence and timing of key operational events and milestones; methods of evaluating the effectiveness of planning actions related to actual events; and the relationship of the various command entities involved in overall program planning and execution of military operations and evaluations.
Demonstrated expertise in the application of military space operations as applicable to CCMD objectives, programs and weapons systems.
Proven track record designing and conducting comprehensive studies and preparing solutions to especially broad, important, and severe military operational and contingency areas.
At least one year of demonstrated expertise at the next lower broadband/grade level (or equivalent) performing Program Analyst duties.
Be able to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI Security Clearance.
Be a [Location masked] Citizen.

Substantial ability to plan and organize studies or projects and to negotiate effectively with management to accept and implement recommendations, where proposals involve substantial resources, and require extensive changes in established concepts and procedures.
Exceptional communication skills, both oral and written; strong ability to negotiate complex issues and maintain effective working relationships.
Significant knowledge and experience in Joint and/or Space operations.

cond_0309.requirements:

Working knowledge of qualitative and/or quantitative methods for assessing and improving command level plans and programs across military mission areas (such as space propulsion, electronic warfare, directed energy, cyber, AI/ML, multi-domain effects, and xGEO), including areas like PPBE, acquisition, or similar operations.
Familiarity with military program goals and objectives; key operational events and milestones; and the relationship between command entities involved in program planning and execution.
Background in applying military space operations concepts to CCMD objectives, programs, and weapons systems.
Around one year of experience at the next lower broadband/grade level (or equivalent) performing Program Analyst duties, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI Security Clearance.

Ability to plan and organize projects and work with management to implement recommendations, even where proposals involve significant resources or changes to established procedures.
Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing; willingness to work through complex issues; and openness to building good working relationships.

You will regularly engage with branch, division, and command stakeholders to articulate and develop requirements processes, as well as advanced concepts and experimentation in Research and Development (R&D) and Science and Technology (S&T) for space.
cond_0573.responsibilities:
Perform substantive planning, advocacy, and requirements work in support of one or more command programs and missions spanning eight mission areas (space propulsion, sustained space maneuver / operations, electronic warfare, directed energy, cyber, artificial intelligence / machine learning, multi-domain effects, and xGEO).
Stay in active contact with stakeholders across the command to integrate, coordinate, prioritize, and advocate for future concepts, mission capability needs, weapon systems development, emerging technologies, and command and control architecture across mission areas.
Support system allocation, modernization, force management, and analysis, regularly communicating findings and trade-offs to relevant parties.
Support development of Commander, [Company name masked]'s Planning, Programming, Budgeting and Executing (PPBE) in the Science and Technology arena, walking leadership through recommendations and clarifying requirements as needed.
Initiate discussions and bring together relevant stakeholders to resolve issues related to mission planning and program execution across the eight mission areas.
cond_0573.requirements:
Knowledge of a wide range of qualitative and/or quantitative methods for the assessment and improvement of command level plans and programs for conducting major operations across eight different mission areas (to include space propulsion, sustained space maneuver / operations, electronic warfare, directed energy, cyber, artificial intelligence / machine learning, multi-domain effects, and xGEO), and associated mission and flight operations, tactical space lift, deployment, mobilization, exercise, training systems, foreign military sales, Planning, Programming, & Budgeting System (PPBE), congressionally allocated appropriated science and technology funding, acquisition, special operations, or similar operations.
Knowledge of military (including command level) program goals and objectives; the sequence and timing of key operational events and milestones; methods of evaluating the effectiveness of planning actions related to actual events; and the relationship of the various command entities involved in overall program planning and execution of military operations and evaluations.
Knowledge of the application of military space operations as applicable to CCMD objectives, programs and weapons systems.
Skill in designing and conducting comprehensive studies and preparing solutions to especially broad, important, and severe military operational and contingency areas.
Ability to plan and organize studies or projects and to negotiate effectively with management to accept and implement recommendations, where proposals involve substantial resources, and require extensive changes in established concepts and procedures.
Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing; negotiate complex issues; and maintain good working relationships.
Knowledge and experience in Joint and/or Space operations is highly desirable.
At least one year of experience at the next lower broadband/grade level (or equivalent) in performing Program Analyst duties.
Be able to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI Security Clearance.
Occasional travel away from the regular duty location may be required.
